title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: equipment rate classes and product entry conditions
content:
## Scope

This reference sets out, for the six products of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, how an equipment type maps to a rate class, which rate classes each product may be applied to, the lowest service contract tier rank a product requires, and how each product comes onto a per-container record.

## Equipment type to rate class

All six products (AHL Tariff Free Time, AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14, AHL Combined Free Time 21 and AHL Contract Free Time 30) use the same mapping.

| Equipment type | Rate class |
|---|---|
| 20DV, 40DV, 40HC, 45HC | dry |
| 20RF, 40RH | reefer |
| 20OT, 40OT, 20FR, 40FR, 20TK | special |

## Eligible rate classes, contract threshold and entry route

| Product | Rate classes the product may be applied to | Lowest service contract tier rank | How the product comes onto a record |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | dry, reefer, special | 0 (no contract needed) | applied by default when a record opens |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | dry, reefer, special | 0 (no contract needed) | bought on a running record |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | dry, reefer | 0 (no contract needed) | bought on a running record |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | dry, reefer, special | 0 (no contract needed) | bought on a running record |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | dry only | 0 (no contract needed) | bought on a running record |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | dry, reefer, special | 4 | applied at opening to a booking rated under a service contract of at least that tier rank whose status is active |

The contract threshold column states the lowest service contract tier rank whose bookings are opened on the product; a threshold of 0 means no contract is needed.

## Points of judgement

**Q: Which rate class does a 40HC container map to?**
A: The dry class, under every product.

**Q: May AHL Free Time Extension 7 be applied to a 20TK tank container?**
A: No. A 20TK maps to the special class, and AHL Free Time Extension 7 may be applied only to the dry and reefer classes.

**Q: Which rate classes may AHL Combined Free Time 21 be applied to?**
A: The dry class only; a reefer-class or special-class container is outside its list.
